feat(feed): a frame is drawn when the bar next changes, not at a fixed 30 fps (candybar-animation-wbxz.014)

A feed chose between two fixed periods by whether its last frame moved, so
a 1 s template `frames` was drawn 30 times a second with 29 frames dropped
as repeated bytes. Every animation a frame draws now says when it next
changes on one host clock, and the feed draws the next frame then: no
closer than its spacing, no further apart than the still period.

- The session's animation clock is a rich-js Timeline. Templates' `frames`
  and `stepped` run through it and stamp their holds on wall time; the
  draw hears the holds of functions that stamp no cell (onHold).
- Each effect part carries the timeline it counts on: loops and passages
  the session's, the closing flash the host clock at rate 1. The flash is
  one animation over the idle period, so a frame announces its start.
- A row's and a frame's `nextChange` replace the `moves` boolean; motion
  is read off that one value.
- The feed owns the instant each frame is drawn for, kept within the
  timer's resolution of the wall clock, so a frame set for a change shows
  it however its timer fires.
- The rate cell shows the feed's ceiling, `≤30 fps` / `≤1 fps`.
refactor(check): an explicit target is one layer, spelled once (candybar-plugins-vf6g.chl)

test(check): a cwd config in an approved repository is a repo layer (candybar-plugins-vf6g.chl)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(config): check reports scoped layers, and a load reports the chain it loaded (candybar-plugins-vf6g.chl)

Review: the check outcome dropped each layer's scope, so callers rebuilt a
different chain from it; an explicit check took its layer by hand instead of
the resolution's; the load frame carried a second copy of the chain's paths.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(config): a config layer carries its own scope, not a parallel repoLayers list (candybar-plugins-vf6g.chl)

Each chain layer is {path, scope}, the scope decided once where discovery
finds the file. repoLayers is gone from the resolution, the durable home,
the session, the render cache's chain and its load key, and the loader
reads layer.scope instead of testing path membership. Hand-built chains
(check's explicit file, demo, gallery, bench, the durable writer's home)
state the user's scope through one helper, homeLayer.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(colour): the ✖ is held to a named red on every ground the sweep draws (candybar-joiners-e5r4.i30)

The palette-identity sweep draws the bundled variation only, and the contrast sweep checked the ink only on listed grounds, so a synthesised red that cleared the floor under another variation went unseen. The contrast sweep now holds every door's ink to the theme's named reds. The selector's doc says the fallback is taken whenever the walk finds none, and clears wherever any named colour does.

fix(colour): roleTextOn walks out from the role's own colour, so the theme's red wins where it reads (candybar-joiners-e5r4.i30)

The walk after text-<role> skipped the role itself while the farthest-off fallback counted it, so on a ground where the base red clears and the text colour does not, a rung was taken over the theme's own red. No bundled door ground changes; roleTextOn is a template function, and its answer elsewhere now follows the rule it states. The private selector is renamed apart from decor's sliding roleText, and the seam's doc names every function it binds.

test(colour): the door's ✖ is held on every ground a variation opens it on, and the design doc states its rule (candybar-joiners-e5r4.i30)

The sweep ran the default variation only, but the door's ground is its variation's menu hue at the dial's pressed rung, so a variation with another lineage gives the ✖ another ground. It now draws every dial position under the bundled variation and every variation at each pressed rung, split by theme so each test stays inside the suite's time limit, and lists the farthest-off red by the ground's palette name. 22 of 23 themes now list a ground; only textual-ansi clears everywhere.

fix(colour): the door's open ✖ wears the theme's text-red, so it reads on its activated ground (candybar-joiners-e5r4.i30)

The open door's ✖ now selects among the reds the theme names for its error
role instead of wearing the base red: `text-error` where it clears
TEXT_MIN_CONTRAST on the pressed state as truecolor draws it, otherwise the
first rung of the error ladder out toward the pole the ground stands farther
from that clears, and where none clears, the named red standing farthest off.
It never slides lightness and is never a synthesised colour; `keptOn` still
holds its contrast through rounding at 256 and ansi.

A new rig test opens the door under every bundled theme and dial position at
truecolor, 256 and ansi and measures the ✖ as drawn; it lists the themes where
no named red clears, with the red worn and the ratio reached. The palette
identity test now holds the ✖ to the theme's error reds.
fix(test): the log line is spelled once, and a timed-out click's event waits on the click's reply budget (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)
fix(test): a log read judges only whole lines, the reporter pairs each failure with its own block, and the click stand-in leaves no timer behind (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)
fix(test): a failure jest would print blank names its message and the file it landed in (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)
fix(test): a click answered TIMEOUT takes its outcome from the daemon's click event, and is never sent twice (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)

* fix(tmux): reset-all's memory line matches the gated reset, a refused tmux follower is told it needs a tmux pane, and a hintless click's in-tmux reading is cited (candybar-plugins-vf6g.qzx)

* fix(picker): a catalogue page laid out as one line stays closed on its segment's ground (candybar-plugins-vf6g.qzx)

* fix(tmux): rebase onto main — the picker reads the band by its palette and disclosure, and the default menu's toggles bytes drop the retired tmux toggle (candybar-plugins-vf6g.qzx)

* test(tmux): the default menu's toggles bytes drop the retired tmux toggle, over main's menu (candybar-plugins-vf6g.qzx)
